full_name: Kim Vaz-Deville | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2023–2024 Humanities Lillian Gollay Knafel Fellow Xavier University of Louisiana
bio: Kim Vaz-Deville is a professor of education at Xavier University of Louisiana whose work in New Orleans focuses on the lives of African Americans from the early 20th century to the present, explicitly on their material and intangible culture.
